title: Cedarline Summit Closing Cost and Settlement Schedule
content:
Settlement terms of the Cedarline Summit Proprietary Reverse Mortgage, by plan. The origination fee is a percent of the initial principal limit, capped at the dollar figure shown; the minimum initial draw is the smallest share of the principal limit drawn at closing; the rescission period is counted in rescission business days (every calendar day except Sundays and federal legal public holidays).

| Plan | Origination fee, percent of principal limit | Origination fee cap | Closing costs may be paid from loan proceeds | Drawn at closing, at least | Rescission period |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Summit Fixed Lump Sum | 2% | USD 20000.00 | yes | 100% | 3 rescission business days |
| Summit Flex Fixed | 2% | USD 20000.00 | yes | 50% | 3 rescission business days |
| Summit Select Line | 1.5% | USD 20000.00 | yes | 0% | 3 rescission business days |
| Summit Condo Line | 2% | USD 15000.00 | yes | 0% | 3 rescission business days |
| Summit Second Lien | 2% | USD 10000.00 | yes | 100% | 3 rescission business days |
| Summit Estate Line | 1% | USD 30000.00 | yes | 0% | 3 rescission business days |

## The origination fee

The origination fee is the plan's percentage of the initial principal limit, and where that product exceeds the plan's cap the fee is the cap. Under every plan the fee may be financed from the loan proceeds.

### Worked figures (hypothetical principal limits)

| Plan | Hypothetical principal limit | Percentage applied | Fee before cap | Fee charged |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Summit Select Line | USD 812500.00 | 1.5% | USD 12187.50 | USD 12187.50 (under the USD 20000.00 cap) |
| Summit Select Line | USD 1640000.00 | 1.5% | USD 24600.00 | USD 20000.00 (the cap) |
| Summit Condo Line | USD 615250.00 | 2% | USD 12305.00 | USD 12305.00 (under the USD 15000.00 cap) |
| Summit Condo Line | USD 812500.00 | 2% | USD 16250.00 | USD 15000.00 (the cap) |

## The draw at closing

Summit Fixed Lump Sum and Summit Second Lien loans are drawn in full at closing (100% of the principal limit). A Summit Flex Fixed loan draws at least half (50%) at closing. The Summit Select Line, Summit Condo Line and Summit Estate Line set no minimum (0%).
